done_when: forge upgrade run in a fix worktree says to drop that fix and run forge upgrade from the main checkout, with the exact commands, and forge next names forge upgrade <release> when a newer Forge release exists than the repo pins.
why: In a client repo, an agent asked to upgrade Forge runs forge fix start, but forge upgrade refuses in that fix's worktree, so the agent drops the fix and starts again (issue #1483).
